name: PostgreSQL
note: PCA 考证中，主力扩展方向

items.title: 版本 / uptime / 连接数
items.notes: version() 和 pg_postmaster_start_time() 在所有 12+ 版本都有，连接数含后台进程。

items.title: WAL 生成量
items.notes: pg_stat_wal 仅 14+ 有，12/13 查 pg_stat_archiver + pg_current_wal_lsn()。

items.title: 后台进程状态
items.sql:
SELECT backend_type, state, count(*) AS cnt
FROM pg_stat_activity
GROUP BY backend_type, state
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT pid, backend_type, state, now() - query_start AS duration, left(query, 200) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active'
ORDER BY query_start
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: backend_type 区分 autovacuum / walsender / checkpointer 等后台进程。

items.title: shared_buffers / work_mem 建议
items.notes: 只读查询参数，不改配置；调参要结合内存总量和连接数，改完需 reload/重启看 context。

items.title: 缓存命中率（heap / index）
items.sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname,
       heap_blks_read, heap_blks_hit,
       round(100.0 * heap_blks_hit / NULLIF(heap_blks_hit + heap_blks_read, 0), 2) AS heap_hit_pct,
       idx_blks_read, idx_blks_hit,
       round(100.0 * idx_blks_hit / NULLIF(idx_blks_hit + idx_blks_read, 0), 2) AS idx_hit_pct
FROM pg_statio_user_tables
ORDER BY heap_blks_read DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: heap 命中率低于 99% 且读盘大时先看 shared_buffers 和热点表。

items.title: 统计信息 / ANALYZE 状态
items.sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_mod_since_analyze,
       last_analyze, last_autoanalyze
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY n_mod_since_analyze DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: n_mod_since_analyze 大且 last_analyze 很旧，说明统计信息过期。

items.title: 自动 VACUUM 状态
items.sql:
SELECT name, setting, unit
FROM pg_settings
WHERE name LIKE 'autovacuum%'
ORDER BY name;
SELECT schemaname, relname, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze,
       autovacuum_count, autoanalyze_count
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY last_autovacuum NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: autovacuum 关了或 long-running 事务堵住时，死元组会一直涨。

items.title: 未使用索引
items.sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, indexrelname AS index_name,
       idx_scan, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(indexrelid)) AS index_size
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE idx_scan = 0
  AND indexrelname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(indexrelid) DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: idx_scan=0 只说明统计周期内没用过，删前确认统计周期够长且不是唯一约束索引。

items.title: 缺失索引（hypopg 评估）
items.notes: hypopg 是第三方扩展，需先 CREATE EXTENSION hypopg；它只做假设，不建真实索引。

items.title: 膨胀索引 / bloat 评估
items.notes: pgstatindex 一次只能查一个索引，全库 bloat 需循环或用 pgstattuple 的近似估算查询。

items.title: pg_stat_statements Top SQL
items.sql:
-- 前置（一次）：CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements;
-- PG 13+ 用 total_exec_time / mean_exec_time；PG 12 用 total_time / mean_time
SELECT query, calls,
       round(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_exec_time_ms,
       round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS mean_exec_time_ms,
       rows
FROM pg_stat_statements
ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: 需先 CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements 并在 shared_preload_libraries 里加载，PG 12 列名是 total_time/mean_time。

items.title: 慢查询日志（log_min_duration）
items.notes: log_min_duration_statement 单位是毫秒，设 1000 即只记 >1s 的；改配置用 ALTER SYSTEM + reload。

items.title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE
items.sql:
-- 把 <query_text> 换成要分析的 SQL；真实执行，会跑完查询
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT TEXT) <query_text>;
items.notes: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 会真实执行，大查询/写操作先在测试库跑，别在生产直接跑。

items.title: 阻塞锁链（pg_blocking_pids）
items.sql:
SELECT blocked.pid AS blocked_pid, blocked.usename AS blocked_user,
       blocked.application_name, blocked.state,
       now() - blocked.query_start AS blocked_duration,
       blocking.pid AS blocking_pid, blocking.usename AS blocking_user,
       left(blocked.query, 200) AS blocked_query
FROM pg_stat_activity blocked
JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking
  ON blocking.pid = ANY (pg_blocking_pids(blocked.pid))
WHERE cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(blocked.pid)) > 0
ORDER BY blocked_duration DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: pg_blocking_pids() 返回阻塞该会话的 pid 数组，根因一般是排头的 blocking_pid。

items.title: 死锁统计
items.sql:
SELECT datname, deadlocks, stats_reset
FROM pg_stat_database
ORDER BY deadlocks DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: pg_stat_database 只有死锁次数，没有死锁明细，明细要去日志里找 deadlock detected。

items.title: 终止会话（pg_terminate_backend）
items.sql:
-- 第 1 步：先确认要杀的会话（长运行活跃会话）
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state,
       now() - query_start AS duration, left(query, 200) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active'
  AND now() - query_start > interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 20;
-- DANGER：确认 pid 无误后再取消注释执行，杀错会话会中断业务
-- SELECT pg_terminate_backend(<pid>);
items.notes: 先查清 pid、用户和 SQL 再杀；pg_terminate_backend 会直接断开该连接。

items.title: 库 / 表大小 Top
items.sql:
SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS db_size
FROM pg_database
ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT schemaname, relname,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS table_size,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid) - pg_relation_size(relid)) AS index_size
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: pg_total_relation_size 含表+索引+TOAST，单看表大小用 pg_relation_size。

items.title: 表膨胀 / VACUUM 建议
items.notes: VACUUM 不锁表，VACUUM FULL 会独占锁并重写表，两者不要混用。

items.title: 死元组比例
items.sql:
SELECT schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup,
       round(100.0 * n_dead_tup / NULLIF(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup, 0), 2) AS dead_pct,
       last_autovacuum
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: 死元组占比高且 autovacuum 没跟上时，先查长事务是否堵住了 VACUUM。

items.title: pg_dump / pg_dumpall
items.sql:
-- shell: pg_dump -h <host> -U <user> -d <db_name> -F c -f <backup_path>.dump
-- shell: pg_dump -h <host> -U <user> -d <db_name> -F p -f <backup_path>.sql
-- shell: pg_dumpall -h <host> -U <user> -f <backup_path>-globals.sql
-- shell: pg_dump --version
items.notes: pg_dump 是逻辑备份，大库慢；-F c 是自定义格式，恢复用 pg_restore。

items.title: pg_basebackup 物理备份
items.sql:
-- shell: pg_basebackup -h <host> -U <replicator_user> -D <backup_dir> -Ft -z -P -v -X stream
-- shell: pg_basebackup -h <host> -U <replicator_user> -D <backup_dir> -Fp -P -v -X stream
items.notes: pg_basebackup 需复制账号有 REPLICATION 权限，-X stream 才会把 WAL 一起备走。

items.title: PITR（WAL + recovery_target_time）
items.notes: PITR 要求归档连续、WAL 不缺；12+ 用 recovery.signal，不再用 recovery.conf。

items.title: 主从延迟（pg_stat_replication）
items.sql:
SELECT application_name, client_addr, state, sync_state,
       pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS replay_lag_bytes,
       replay_lag, write_lag, flush_lag
FROM pg_stat_replication
ORDER BY replay_lag DESC
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: replay_lag 是备库回放延迟，write/flush 延迟大而 replay 小时说明回放跟不上。

items.title: 同步 / 异步模式检查
items.notes: synchronous_standby_names 为空即异步；同步模式下主库提交要等备库确认。

items.title: 角色 / 权限清单
items.sql:
SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin,
       rolconnlimit, rolvaliduntil
FROM pg_roles
ORDER BY rolname
LIMIT 20;
SELECT grantee, table_schema, table_name, privilege_type
FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
ORDER BY grantee, table_schema, table_name
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: pg_roles 看角色属性，表级授权看 role_table_grants，两者要分开查。

items.title: 行级安全（RLS）检查
items.sql:
SELECT schemaname, tablename, rowsecurity AS rls_enabled, relforcerowsecurity
FROM pg_tables
WHERE rowsecurity
ORDER BY schemaname, tablename
LIMIT 20;
SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd
FROM pg_policies
ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, policyname
LIMIT 20;
items.notes: RLS 只对表所有者之外的用户生效，超级用户和表所有者默认绕过。
